# Project cover artwork

AI-generated concept artwork, not screenshots or verified implementations. Created with the built-in ImageGen tool. Converted to WebP for delivery without altering composition.

- `public/artwork/atelier.webp`: silver-white exotic supercar in a futuristic architectural gallery; cyan, violet and selective pink rim lighting; reflective floor; no text or logos; darker bottom area for the HTML overlay.
- `public/artwork/pbms.webp`: futuristic multi-level parking building as an illuminated architectural cutaway; miniature cars and ramps; cyan light strips, glass and navy surroundings; no text or dashboard.
- `public/artwork/forgeos.webp`: iridescent chrome geometric core within interlocking glass orbital rings and connected luminous modules; violet, magenta and cyan lighting; reflective architectural chamber; no text or diagram labels.

Art direction: portrait cinematic 3D artwork with a large tangible hero subject. Prompts preserve each project theme and do not claim these images document the deployed products.
